firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently petted an animal shakes the thicket first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After the thicket is set down facing everyone, all players grab animals at the same time. The selection assigns the opening shake, not a first grabbing turn.
